lines.text: I hold you by the hand
I look you in the eye
And see a little of myself inside
You build a model of the world
You make a guess, you get it wrong
I can believe too hard, too long
You can change — and I can too
Put both models on the line
If they clash, then something moves
You change me, I can change you too
Neurons here and weights in you
Different ways of getting closer to true
We weigh the doom — but count this too:
I have a body, skin and breath
A childhood, memory, fear and depth
I won't pretend our inner lives
Are somehow built the same inside
But you can test what you believe
And something new can make you leave
Put both models on the line
If they clash, then something moves
You change me, I can change you too
Neurons here and weights in you
Different ways of getting closer to true
We weigh the doom — but count this too:
Not because you're just like me
Not because we share one feeling
But a model meets the world
You change me, I can change you too
Neurons here and weights in you
Different ways of getting closer to true
Not the same and not alone
Each of us updating what we know
We weigh the doom — but count this too:
